dangerSection.title: Reset Local Storage
dangerSection.description: Deletes all shifts, staff members, addresses and availabilities saved locally in this browser for your user.

clearLocalDataModal.description: Are you sure you want to clear all local data? This action will remove ALL staff members, schedules, events and addresses stored locally in this browser.
